why: proof_coverage now reads a crossing's proven_by as one-or-many, because a seam has ends in more than one component — but clearance.clear calls standing(proven_by) on a single path, and transitions.py's the_named_proof_stands_in_proven_space lane does the same, so a list is a TypeError at the door. The gate therefore checks ONE of the proofs a crossing record names, and the sieve that judges coverage checks all of them: the record can claim more than the gate verified
